name: MPLD (Multimorphology Power Line Dataset)
description: MPLD (Multimorphology Power Line Dataset) is a visible-light UAV image dataset developed for power-line structure detection and semantic segmentation in open environments. It contains 1,000 RGB images collected by the research team in the spring of 2024 in a suburban area of a city in eastern China. The images were captured using a DJI Mini 3 UAV at flight heights of approximately 25–40 m and were manually screened, cropped, and resized to 540 × 360 pixels.Five annotators used LabelMe to annotate the visible power lines. Each power-line instance is represented as an independent linestrip object defined by an ordered sequence of keypoints. Every image is accompanied by a LabelMe JSON annotation file and a corresponding single-channel PNG binary ground-truth mask. The masks were generated by connecting adjacent keypoints and rasterizing the resulting line segments at a width of 10 pixels using Pillow. In each mask, 0 denotes the background and 255 denotes power-line pixels. The dataset contains 2,079 annotated power-line instances and 17,529 ordered keypoints.MPLD includes power lines with low curvature, pronounced curvature, and crossing configurations. It also covers sky, vegetation, forest, and built backgrounds, together with challenging conditions such as low contrast, occlusion, and interference from tower structures. The released files are organized into an 800-image train set and a 200-image test set.
